name: Fujichrome Astia 100F
source: Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., FUJICHROME ASTIA 100F Professional [RAP100F] Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-149E (2003-11), page 8

notes.characteristic: Exposure daylight 1/50 s, process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A).
notes.sensitivity: Process E-6/CR-56, densitometry Fuji FAD-30S (Status A), density 1.0 above D-min, sensitivity = 1/exposure (J/cm2).
notes.dye_density: Spectral diffuse density of each dye, exposure separated light, process E-6/CR-56; normalized to a peak of 1.0, no viewing illuminant stated.

grain.note: Diffuse RMS granularity, read at a gross diffuse visual density of 1.0 using a 48-micrometre aperture.
